correctness.rationale: With N=2^d, each length-2 factor is σ_r(1,t_r), where independent fair signs σ_r,t_r yield a column equal to ± one fixed Walsh–Hadamard vector h_T, T uniform among N orthogonal labels. Hence ΨΨᵀ eigenvalues are exactly NC_t/m for multinomial occupancies C_t with total m; rank N iff every bin nonempty, and inclusion–exclusion gives its exact finite probability. For ε∈(0,1), m=⌊cNlogN⌋, the near-isometry condition is simultaneous |C_t−m/N|≤ε m/N. Chernoff rates H_+=(1+ε)ln(1+ε)−ε and H_−=ε+(1−ε)ln(1−ε) satisfy H_->H_+; for cH_+>1 union bound gives success with probability→1. For cH_+<1, letting Z count bins above (1+ε)m/N, a local binomial lower bound plus Stirling gives EZ=N^{1−cH_++o(1)}→∞. Conditional binomial monotonicity gives pairwise nonpositive covariances for high-occupancy indicators, so Var Z≤EZ and P(Z=0)→0. The critical coefficient c*=1/H_+ is sharp on both open sides; c=c* is explicitly unproved. An independent 5-small-tensor-count Walsh diagonalization and exact occupancy/rank check reproduced the finite spectral identity; bounded tests are not the asymptotic proof.
